title: enhance: canary + shadow autorollback workflow improvements
author: Aisha Kapoor
release_notes: Improved canary + shadow autorollback workflow: enhanced metric quorums, staged probing, observability for rollback decisions, e2e tests and safety guards. Backwards-compatible; no customer action required.
description:
Context: We observed a few production rollouts where transient telemetry noise caused unnecessary rollbacks or delayed safe rollouts. This PR improves the canary + shadow autorollback workflow by adding staged probing, quorumed metric evaluation, and richer observability so operators can trace why a rollback decision happened. Motivation: reduce false-positive rollbacks, speed up safe rollouts, and make rollback decisions auditable for postmortems.

What this PR does: - Add staged probing step before full quarantine: short, low-traffic probes against the new model to validate suspected regressions. - Implement metric quorum: require a configurable number of independent metrics (latency, error-rate, model-quality) to trip before triggering an automatic rollback. - Extend rollback engine to support temporary quarantine state and conditional auto-retry (do-not-rollback-if-probing-pass). - Emit structured rollback decision events (reason, metrics snapshot, quorum components) to observability pipeline and add dashboard panels. - Add canary-simulation harness used in CI to validate decision logic deterministically. - Add e2e test suite that reproduces historical incidents and asserts no regressions. - Documentation updates and migration notes for rollout policies.

Risk and compatibility: Behavior is opt-in via rollout policy fields; defaults preserve current autorollback behavior. The quorum and probing timeouts are tunable per-customer. No breaking API changes.

Testing performed: unit tests for quorum logic, integration tests for rollback engine state transitions, CI canary-sim runs (deterministic), and new e2e scenarios in the stability testbed. We replayed traces from INC-4532 and confirmed the new probing step prevented a noisy rollback while still catching true regressions.

Rollout plan: Merge to main behind feature flag rollouts.autorollback.v2. Enable for internal canaries for 2 weeks, then enable for low-traffic customers, monitor the rollback_decision dashboard and adjust thresholds.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for quorum and probing logic
- [x] Integration tests for rollback state machine
- [x] e2e scenarios added and green in CI
- [x] Dashboard + logging for decision traceability
- [x] Docs and migration notes

Related: Linear ENG-1982 (autorollback false positives), ENG-2050 (rollback observability), INC-4532 (customer incident)
